$comment: Findings that do not fail the run (scripts/security-report.mjs). Each entry names the tool, the id of the finding (a CVE, a rule), optionally a part of its location (where), why and until when (YYYY-MM-DD): after that date it fails the run again and must be looked at once more. "kind": "false-positive": not a vulnerability of this code (the tool is wrong, or the flagged flow is intended and safe: the reason says why); without kind: an accepted risk, a real weakness kept for the reason given. The report counts both apart from the open findings.

the path of a host's configuration is built from a host type every caller passes as a constant (proxy_host, redirection_host, dead_host, stream, default) and the integer id of its database row; nothing of a request reaches it
the cookie holds the session token itself, as every login does: signed, httpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Strict, __Host- prefix
the condition only rejects an empty token; every other token goes through jwt.verify with the public key
the length of the code chooses how it is checked: 6 digits by TOTP, 8 characters against the bcrypt hashes of the backup codes; any other length is refused, both checks throw on a mismatch
cert_id is the integer id of a certificate row in the URL path, not a certificate or a key: CodeQL takes any name with "cert" for secret data
certificate_id and expand are the id of a row and the names of related objects, not secrets: CodeQL takes any name with "cert" for secret data
the Gravatar download: NginxionS fixes DISABLE_GRAVATAR=true (docs/ENV-INVENTORY.md), so the branch does not run; the file name is a sha256 and the extension one of png, jpeg, gif
the block page is what the administrator configures (WAF -> Block page), rendered with escaping into its own fixed file
a CSR the administrator uploads is stored for its certificate (a directory 0700 per certificate id) or checked by openssl in a private temporary directory
the log of a failed ACME request is written, with the secrets redacted, to its fixed file for "Full log"
a hub snapshot the administrator uploads, or hub files downloaded on the administrator's request: paths are checked by safeRel (normalized, no .., not absolute), archives may hold plain files only
the GeoIP database the administrator uploads is checked by the reader before it replaces the file (a fixed path, written as .tmp and renamed)
inputs of openssl written as 0600 files of a private temporary directory, removed afterwards
the credentials NginxionS reads from its secrets volume are sent to the local CrowdSec LAPI they belong to (internal network)
the token of nginxions-control, read from the secrets volume, is sent to nginxions-control on 127.0.0.1 only

the Docker socket is for nginxions-control alone (System -> Services): a whitelist of operations on containers labelled nginxions.managed, a token, an audit log, 127.0.0.1 only; the container nginxions, which takes traffic from the internet, has no socket (CLAUDE.md, Security)

the shared memory queues between nginx (its workers run as their own user in the container nginxions) and the agent (root in the container openappsec): both must write them. The IPC namespace (/dev/shm) is private to these two containers (ipc: service:openappsec), no other user or container sees it
the Unix sockets of the agent under /dev/shm/check-point, written by the nginx attachment of the other container: see shmem_ipc, the namespace is private to the two containers
cpnano is the command-line tool of the operator inside the container; the variable (the path of the agent's files) is set by whoever runs it, who can already read and write every file there
the request logging middleware logs only the headers it is given: X-Correlation-Id, X-Request-Id and X-Trace-Id (routers.go), ids of a request, no credential
the logs are JSON (openappsec.io/log: formatter -> json.Marshal), a value with a line break is escaped inside its string and cannot forge an entry
the lock key has every '/' replaced by '-' before it is joined to the lock directory: it names a file of that directory and nothing else (smartsync is not built into the image)

every path of the REST API goes through inRoot (filepath.Clean, then a prefix check against the root): '../' is refused, fileSystemDB_nginxions_test.go reads, writes and lists outside the root and fails
